findings.reason: the node's write paths and reader list must name tests/llm/test_prompt_schema_coverage.py so the decisions template either keeps a schema-coverage path or adjusts EXPECTED_PROMPTS, otherwise a node implementing §25 as written leaves the suite red.
findings.text: §25 rewrites imas_codex/llm/prompts/code/triage.md into a decisions template and moves the code triage call off call_llm_structured(response_model=...) onto call_decisions, which carries questions rather than a pydantic response model; but test_walk_reaches_expected_prompts asserts `EXPECTED_PROMPTS - set(pairs)` is empty, EXPECTED_PROMPTS pins "code/triage" at :32, and _collect_pairs() (:155) admits a prompt only from a call site carrying a response_model kwarg; the rewrite therefore drops "code/triage" from the pair set and turns the guarded test red, and §25 names no such reconciliation

findings.reason: a node following the plan's reader list narrowly changes the production queries while leaving these pins asserting the retired field, so the suite goes red at the head; the migration list should name the tests it must co-update.
findings.text: §25 states "every reader of the retired fields migrates in the same node" and lists imas_codex/discovery/code/scorer.py, graph_ops.py, progress.py, workers.py, parallel.py and _CODE_TRIAGE_FIELDS in imas_codex/discovery/base/reset.py, but the pinned claim tests also read the retired CodeFile triage fields: tests/discovery/test_code_claims_prefix_scope.py:63/:67/:74 assert on `sf.triage_composite IS NULL` and `min_triage`, and tests/discovery/test_claims_honour_exclusions.py:48/:69 pass min_triage_composite to has_pending_enrich_work; the census the plan calls complete omits them

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — call_decisions/acall_decisions (imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py:3429/3493) hide request assembly, per-question answer validation, retry/backoff and cost extraction behind two functions plus three exception types, and build_path_prefix_filter (imas_codex/graph/query_builder.py:282) hides the clause and its parameter binding behind one returned pair.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — verified single owners rather than forks: build_facility_exclusion_filter delegates to build_path_prefix_filter (imas_codex/config/discovery_config.py:565), the additive seed extends GraphClient.create_nodes instead of forking a second writer, and §25 routes the decisions path through the shared `_service_headers`/`_is_retryable` owners rather than a private retry stack.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §25's "Interface account" names what it retires (eleven CodeFile triage fields, the LLM rubric in code/triage.md, code's discovery-triage seat and get_triage_threshold use, ingest's `--min-score` reading) and §14 names its retirements (seed_missing_roots, create_child_paths), so neither section adds to a family without accounting for the surface it removes.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §25 newly cites the call-layer machinery it reuses (call_llm_structured's `_is_retryable`, `DEFAULT_RETRY_BASE_DELAY`, `get_api_key_for_service` at imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py:1188/694/910, and the extracted `_service_headers` at imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py:1995), but does not account for the existing prompt↔response-model guard its `code/triage.md` rewrite collides with (tests/llm/test_prompt_schema_coverage.py:198/:32).
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — build_path_prefix_filter is not a thin forwarder over render_path_prefix_clause: it adds negation, empty-list handling and distinct parameter naming, and serves the path claims (imas_codex/discovery/paths/parallel.py:501-832), the nine code claims (imas_codex/discovery/code/graph_ops.py:133-762) and the exclusion helper; the plan states why the bare renderer cannot carry the binding.
